counter_evidence_review.review_notes: The one-day, all-Claude-authored build pattern reads as a single-session AI capstone, but it is a coherent designed experiment with results artifacts, not a boilerplate dump. Weaknesses are absence of a limitations section and no dependency declaration; the 24/24 and 23/24 scores rest on the runs/ artifacts, which exist but whose contents were not inspected.

notes: A one-day, fully Claude-authored context-engineering experiment (baseline plus four deliberate context breaks with a locked scorer) whose README claims map cleanly onto the commit sequence and root artifacts. The same-symptom/different-root-cause finding and builder/validator separation are genuine original structure. No limitations section, no deps file, and the README does not credit the repo's own AI authorship even though every commit is Claude-authored.
